I'd try the free tier, but three dishes a month is about all I'd actually cook on weeknights, and ChatGPT already gives me a pad kra pao recipe with substitutes for nothing. I don't see why I'd pay on top of the takeaway I'm still going to order.

I want to learn Thai food from a real person whose grandmother cooked it, not from an AI that says it's authentic. I might poke at the free 3 dishes, but I wouldn't pay for Plus when free YouTube channels from actual Thai cooks already exist.

I care who's actually teaching me, and 'an AI Thai chef' tells me nothing about where these recipes come from. I'd try the 3 free dishes, but that's about all I'd cook from it in a month anyway, so I wouldn't pay yet.
